revisionist.

Since the matter has arisen out of 
the matrimonial dispute, hence, in the 
opinion of the Court, an attempt should 
be made by the parties for mediation. 
Learned counsel for the parties 
also agreed for mediation. 
As requested, list this matter on 
20.07.2017. Parties to appear on 
20.07.2017. Noting their presence, 
parties will be referred for mediation on 
that date. 
 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.)
